title: NVIDIA, Güney Kore'nin fiziksel yapay zeka ekosistemini büyütüyor
summary: NVIDIA, Güney Kore'deki teknoloji liderleriyle yarı iletken, otonom sürüş ve robotik alanlarında yeni iş birliklerini duyurdu.
body:
NVIDIA'nın açıklamasına göre şirket, ülkenin üretim ve mühendislik alanındaki güçlü yönlerinden faydalanarak **Güney Kore fiziksel yapay zeka** ekosistemini ilerletmek amacıyla yeni iş birlikleri başlattı. Samsung Electronics, Kakao Mobility, LG Electronics ve Hyundai Motor Group gibi sektör liderleri; hızlandırılmış bilgi işlem, yapay zeka ve simülasyon teknolojilerini üretime entegre etmek için çalışmalara katılıyor.

## Yarı iletken ve otonom sürüş alanındaki yenilikler

Samsung Electronics, yarı iletken inovasyonunu hızlandırmak amacıyla NVIDIA ile iş birliğini genişletiyor. Süreç ve optik simülasyonlar için GPU hızlandırmasından yararlanan Samsung, yapay zeka homojenleştirme vakasında yaklaşık 1.600 kat hız artışı elde ettiğini bildirdi. Öte yandan Kakao Mobility, Seul'ün Gangnam bölgesindeki deneyimini NVIDIA'nın araç bilgi işlem platformuyla birleştirerek seviye 4 otonom sürüş sistemi geliştirmeyi planlıyor.

## Robotik ve güvenli yapay zeka ajanları

LG Electronics, CLOiD robotunu gerçek bir üretim ortamında NVIDIA Isaac GR00T tabanlı olarak başarıyla test etti. Yapay zeka ajanlarının yaygınlaşmasıyla birlikte güvenlik önlemlerine de odaklanan şirketler arasında yer alan AIM Intelligence, Starfort platformunu NVIDIA OpenShell ile entegre etmeye hazırlanıyor. Ayrıca NVIDIA, SK Telecom ve Rebellions ile birlikte egemen yapay zeka altyapısını ilerletmek için çalışacağını duyurdu.

**Neden önemli?** Yapay zekanın sanal ortamdan fiziksel üretime, robotiğe ve yarı iletken tasarımına taşınması, endüstriyel süreçlerde büyük ölçekli verimlilik artışları ve otomasyon imkanları sunuyor.

source_texts.text:
Tapping into the country’s strengths in manufacturing and engineering, NVIDIA is helping advance Korea’s physical AI ecosystem.
The country’s industry leaders are applying accelerated computing, AI and simulation to everything from semiconductor manufacturing to robotics and autonomous vehicles.
These efforts are helping bring physical AI from development into real-world production.
Samsung Advances Semiconductor Engineering With Accelerated Computing and AI Physics
Samsung Electronics is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA to advance semiconductor innovation through accelerated computing and AI physics. The work spans materials research, process development and device engineering.
In technology computer-aided design, Samsung is working with NVIDIA cuISS and NVIDIA cuDSS to accelerate computations involving sparse linear systems. The collaboration also extends to GPU acceleration for process and optical simulations. In materials research, Samsung’s sMOL platform has run selected quantum chemical calculations up to 5x faster end to end with NVIDIA cuEST. Samsung is also exploring NVIDIA cuEquivariance to speed up tensor operations used in training and inference for atomistic AI models.
Samsung is developing chip-scale thermal and mechanical analysis workflows with NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo. In one AI homogenization case, combining AI-predicted effective material properties, coarser grids and GPU acceleration resulted in a roughly 1,600x speedup. Simulation time fell from about 18 hours for a fine-grid solve on a 32-core CPU to 41 seconds for a GPU-accelerated coarse-grid solve.
Looking ahead, NVIDIA Agent Toolkit could connect these simulation tools and AI models, helping future engineering agents run analyses and compare design options.
Kakao Mobility Collaborates With NVIDIA to Advance Autonomous Driving Development
Kakao Mobility plans to build on NVIDIA’s autonomous vehicle computing and safety technologies to advance development of a level 4 autonomous driving system. The work combines Kakao Mobility’s proprietary driving software and experience operating in Seoul’s Gangnam district with NVIDIA’s vehicle computing platform.
Kakao Mobility plans to use NVIDIA Hyperion, a reference platform for vehicle sensors and compute, powered by NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor. It also plans to use NVIDIA Halos to support safety across the development and validation of its autonomous driving technology.
Initial development is planned around Kia purpose-built vehicles, integrating Kakao Mobility’s autonomous driving software with NVIDIA technologies. The effort aims to support future level 4 mobility services in Korea.
LG Electronics Advances Robot Learning and Factory Simulation
NVIDIA and LG Electronics successfully demonstrated NVIDIA Isaac GR00T-powered robotic manipulation and manufacturing tasks using LG’s CLOiD robot in an actual manufacturing environment.
The collaboration implemented a physical AI data flywheel connecting real-world data collection, NVIDIA Cosmos-based data augmentation, GR00T model training, NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor onboard computing and simulation-based evaluation, establishing reusable workflows for continued development and validation of CLOiD’s robotic capabilities.
The teams are using this work to refine a repeatable process for training, evaluating and improving robots for manufacturing.

source_texts.text:
As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them.
Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints and the NVIDIA OpenShell runtime, while AIM Intelligence is integrating its Starfort platform with NVIDIA OpenShell to support secure AI agents for employee productivity and enterprise workflows.
A key component of the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform, OpenShell provides a secure runtime with sandboxed execution and policy-based controls to safeguard sensitive data, manage access to enterprise tools and govern autonomous agent actions.
AIM Intelligence, a Korean AI security company, is integrating its Starfort agent control platform with NVIDIA OpenShell. The goal is to combine OpenShell’s runtime access controls with Starfort’s detection of malicious instructions and data leakage. The company is also considering a preliminary proof of concept for the public energy sector, with potential applications across enterprise, industrial and robotics environments.
On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea.
Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts. NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open models, datasets and techniques that help developers build specialized, efficient AI agents.
Learn more about NVIDIA Nemotron open models and get started building secure agents with NVIDIA OpenShell.

source_texts.text:
NVIDIA and Korea’s Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT) are expanding their collaboration across the country’s sovereign AI ecosystem, from AI semiconductors and data center infrastructure to talent, startups, models, agents and security.
The collaboration lays the groundwork for Korean NPU and XPU companies to explore participation in the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion ecosystem, and includes NVIDIA training and certification programs, hackathons and technical seminars to strengthen GPU utilization.
Through Korea’s AI for All initiative, NVIDIA will collaborate with three selected consortia and four leading Korean foundation model builders, using NVIDIA Dynamo software to optimize and scale AI inference.
In addition, NVIDIA today announced a collaboration with SK Telecom and Rebellions, supported by MSIT, to advance sovereign AI infrastructure for Korean models and workloads with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion. Read more in the press release.
